info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Carrental Reservations Create-v5-spec
info.description: The Carrental Reservations Management API facilitates the seamless creation of car rental reservations for users. This endpoint allows consumers, such as travel agencies or individual users, to submit requests for reserving vehicles quickly and efficiently. Leveraging this API, developers can integrate car rental functionalities into their applications, improving user experience and operational workflow. It serves as a critical tool in the car rental industry, enabling quick access to vehicle availability and booking options.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new reservation in the system. It accepts necessary details about the reservation such as date, time, and guest information, and returns the confirmation of the created reservation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new reservation. It should contain the necessary details about the reservation that are required for processing. Ensure that all required fields are included to avoid errors during the reservation creation.

200.description: The reservation has been successfully created.
